name: afferent-concept-tasks
note: Task art regenerated in the Layers of Light style from design/concept/final/regen.json task_assets.regenerate. Sizes and transparency from art/tasks_plan.json. Run: python3 art/generate.py --plan art/tasks_plan_concept.json --draft --force --only <names>.
style: Calm flat 2D illustration for a wordless Finnish mobile game, in the spirit of 1930s Finnish functionalist design: free-form wave curves and bent laminated birch plywood (inspiration only, no real buildings, furniture or products). Every landform, shoreline, snowdrift, fell and path is one long, smooth, asymmetric free-form curve drawn in a single unhurried gesture: no zigzags, no jagged edges, no hard corners. Every landform is laminated: along its curved top edge run two to four thin parallel offset lines in pale birch tones that follow the curve exactly, like the cut edge of bent birch plywood. Shapes are large, flat and matte like smooth painted plaster, each with at most one very soft smooth tonal gradient. Any sky is a perfectly smooth continuous gradient: no banding, no stripes, no scanlines, no noise, no speckle, no grain. No outlines, no brush texture, no paper grain, no 3D render look, no glossy or plastic highlights, no clay or plush look, no photorealism. Strong clear silhouettes, very few elements. Palette: deep fjord #0E1A2E, kaamos blue #1E3150, frost #9DB9CC, lilac haze #B4A6CE, birch white #F2EEE6, birch ply #E2C79C, ply edge #B48E5C, sun yellow #F2C230, honey #FFD58A, dawn apricot #F3A57A, ice #8FC6E0, spring green #9DBE8C, spruce #2F4A48, granite #8A8F9C, ceiling green #C8D6BE. Warm light is sun yellow and honey only, never orange-red, never pink, never coral, never red. Quiet, hopeful, gentle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no faces.
isolated: Isolated element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. Paint it in its natural local colours at middle value under soft even overcast daylight: no cast shadows, no light sources, no glow, no night or sunset tint, muted slightly desaturated colours (never neon or lime), because the game adds darkness, light and colour grading in code. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no sky, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border, no extra buildings, islands or water.
backdrop: Full-bleed portrait illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in, a big calm empty sky, a small figure in a large world, no frame, no border, no vignette.

suffixes.plate: Full-bleed portrait illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in, a big calm empty sky, a small figure in a large world, no frame, no border, no vignette.
suffixes.sky: Isolated sky element on a fully transparent background, orthographic side view. It carries its own light and colour exactly as described, soft and smooth, never neon. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no backdrop, no frame, no vignette, no border.
suffixes.additive: Flat pure black #000000 background filling the whole frame, for additive blending in code: every pixel that is not part of the light itself is exactly black. Nothing else in the image beyond what is named: no land, no water, no trees, no horizon, no stars, no frame, no vignette, no border.
suffixes.panel: Full-bleed flat illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, lighting painted in softly, no frame, no border, no vignette.

assets.name: task_reaction_float
assets.prompt: A single small round wooden fishing float seen exactly from the side, a smooth egg shape with a short thin stick on top, upper half birch ply #E2C79C, lower half kaamos blue #1E3150, one thin ply-edge #B48E5C line at the join, no bead, no light, centred.

assets.name: task_reaction_figure_rod
assets.prompt: Only the single character sitting on a small birch-ply crate, seen exactly from the side facing right, holding a short thin wooden fishing rod forward and slightly up, a thin line hanging from its tip, lantern set down on the crate beside it, full body, centred. The Keeper, the only character: a small, round, child-sized figure about half as wide as it is tall, in a felted wool cloak the colour of birch plywood #E2C79C with a soft kaamos-blue #1E3150 shadow side; a smooth dome-shaped hood that is perfectly round on top (no point, no tip, no ears, no pompom, no fur trim) flowing straight into a cloak that flares gently into a bell shape down to the ground; a hem band of two thin darker ply lines #B48E5C near the bottom of the cloak; no scarf, no staff, no pole. Seen exactly from the side facing right with the hood opening turned away, so no face is ever visible. One small mitten holds a small round lantern on a short handle at hip height, lantern glass dark and unlit.

assets.name: task_reaction_splash_sheet
assets.prompt: Four frames in a row of one small flat water splash, frame by frame: a flat low ring, a small crown, a taller crown of rounded drops, then a few scattered round drops falling back. Smooth flat shapes in birch white #F2EEE6 and ice #8FC6E0, no glow, no sparkle. The frames sit in four exactly equal, evenly spaced cells, each element centred in its cell, the same size baseline in every cell. Composition: one wide, low horizontal arrangement about 4 times as wide as it is tall, spanning the full width, centred vertically, with empty transparent space above and below.
